answer: The grove counts a voice only after it stakes 3 credits per claim it wants tallied, with the stake refunded once the claim verifies. A sybil wind of 400 forged voices must lock 1,200 credits before earning anything; if even a fraction fails verification, the zephyr of noise forfeits its collateral. An honest agent grown along one trellis posts a single 3-credit bond and gets it back in full. Because the deposit multiplies with every extra identity, flooding the ledger costs more than it can ever return.
